topics.title: Research Topics
topics.subtitle: We use molecular simulation, theory, and machine learning to connect molecular motion and arrangement with the behavior of salt solutions, polymer-coated nanoparticles, glasses, and gels.

multiscale.subtitle: We choose the level of detail that matches the question, from electronic changes during a reaction to the collective motion that shapes a material.

recruitment.title: Join the lab
recruitment.howToApplyText: Send your CV and a short note about a research question that interests you. If one of our papers connects to that question, mention it. We welcome applicants who are new to computational chemistry.
recruitment.undergradApplyText: Send a short introduction and tell us what you would like to learn or investigate. We will discuss a suitable starting project when we meet. We welcome beginners in simulation and coding.
recruitment.fieldsText: Chemistry, chemical engineering, physics, materials science, computer science, and related fields.

site.description: We build computer models and machine-learning tools to explain how molecular motion shapes liquids, polymers, and nanomaterials across scales.
